entry.title: Meeting with Valerie - Tranquility Living Pathways
entry.summary: Valerie - resource center - for seniors and those struggling - speciality is senior care - wants to help by working with existing facilities (liason) - helps...
entry.content:
• Valerie
    • resource center - for seniors and those struggling
    • speciality is senior care
    • wants to help by working with existing facilities (liason)
    • helps them navigate funding and finding the right person
    • deciding if seniors should be in their home or in a facility
    • helping seniors navigate the steps
    • services
      • memory care
    • scope of services
    • “make the best decision with them not for them”
    • has a facebook
    • uses canva
      • business cards
    • spends time during the week networking, meeting with hospice facilities
    • desires for a website
    • bizee.com (llc setup)
    • clarity care would be a client of Valerie’s
    • wants family to stay in the family lane
    • her funding model might be long-term care but will probably be private pay (like a consultant)
    • likes her logo (it’s recongnizable)

entry.summary: The idea is something like the AUR, which is ultimately a pointer to a repo with a script that does some setup...
entry.content:
The idea is something like the AUR, which is ultimately a pointer to a repo with a script that does some setup…

Perhaps my Homelab As A Service idea could have its own package manager or repository of one-click type of applications. This could end up being basically any amount of compose files or something with a simple front-end, which is kind of what portainer does though I’m not fluent in its capabilities.
